name: Project X-Nexus Executor
changelog: V1.9.0: Separate saved application and autoexec folder paths for Xeno and Solara, available from Configure paths. Switching executors restores their own paths; missing saved paths are reported without silently selecting another installation. Stop script saving or restore detected paths for each executor. Changing the selected application clears its old autoexec destination. Existing scripts remain untouched when changing preferences.
